create_observed_lstm: create an observed torch.ao.nn.quantizable.LSTM with individually configured observers for gates and states
build_reference_quantized_lstm: build a reference quantized torch.ao.nn.quantized.LSTM from an observed LSTM module with FX graph conversion
test_quantizable_lstm_observer: test the quantizable LSTM with custom observers for linear outputs, sigmoid, tanh, cell state, and hidden state
refactor_lstm_qconfig: refactor the LSTM QConfig mapping to assign per-operation observers using sigmoid, tanh, and cell state controllers
review_lstm_quantization_flow: review the FX graph quantization flow for LSTM including observer insertion and reference conversion
